question: Which three products generated the most revenue?
Which region had the most revenue?

content:
Revenue is the value of completed sales in USD, after discounts and rounding each line. Exclude cancelled and returned lines. Shipping, tax and refund accounting are not part of this model.

Use the table that fits the question: daily_revenue has daily totals; category_revenue and regional_revenue break those totals down by category or region. product_metrics has all-time totals per product, name, category and currency. Do not join these aggregates on date alone, since that would multiply revenue. Calculate AOV as SUM(revenue)/SUM(order_count) from daily_revenue. Do not average daily AOV or add daily active customers to get distinct customers for a period. Product and region order counts can overlap. If a metric is missing, explain that it is unavailable.

The records are fictional and come from the Simulated Retail Customer Data listing on Databricks Marketplace. Purchase orders are assumed completed because the source has no status field. Region is the latest-known customer region. Category comes from sales.product_category, matched by product name; unmatched names become Unknown. Orders with a declared line count that differs from their product array go to quarantine.

question: What is total completed-sales revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM retail_demo.gold.daily_revenue

question: Which three products generated the most revenue?
sql: SELECT product_id, product_name, revenue FROM retail_demo.gold.product_metrics ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id LIMIT 3

question: Which region had the most revenue?
sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM retail_demo.gold.regional_revenue GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC, region LIMIT 1
